description: Atelier's own delivery from main, to the staging server on the Studio: type-check; when the server's code changed since the commit next.atelier.zone reports, build a release of the captured commit, copy it to the Studio and install it there with the installed release's scripts/studio/install-server.sh under sudo, the developer typing the password at sudo's own prompt; verify the live commit; scan for private data; push main to the github remote.
